mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_resources ( uploader_id, original_file_name, stored_file_name, file_extension, mime_type, file_size, storage_path, file_status ) VALUES ( #{uploaderId}, #{originalFileName}, #{storedFileName}, #{fileExtension}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{storagePath}, #{fileStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT file_id, uploader_id, original_file_name, stored_file_name, file_extension, mime_type, file_size, storage_path, file_status FROM file_resources WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
